issues.t: lambda: 7 net-new causes — InvokeWithResponseStream delivers no chunks, GetDurableExecutionState answers NotImplemented, two durable-execution refusal messages are emulator-authored, and three Node.js runtime behaviours
8 net-new causes: Lambda control-plane writes skip documented validation and mis-shape their refusals
